title: Energising Powerful - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Energising Powerful in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Lumiere Act III - after the rooftops, use the grapple and descend

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Energising Powerful is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Give 2 AP on applying Powerful.

sections.title: How to Get Energising Powerful
sections.content: Location: Lumiere Act III - after the rooftops, use the grapple and descend.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
